phases.narrative_purpose: Adapt the continuous working story into sequential film beats.
phases.broad_progression: Follow the expanded story from beginning to end without changing event order or outcomes.
phases.location: As established by the expanded story.

required_events.event: Amy stirs oatmeal on stove while Will and Amber giggle over cereal bowls in the humming morning kitchen.
A groaning shudder cracks the front door as an undead creature bursts in, eyes glazed, arms reaching for her kids.
Quick as a heartbeat, Amy scoops Will into one arm, presses Amber against her chest, and sprints toward the back closet that serves as their safe spot.
She shoves them inside, slams the door shut, turns to face the chaos, then runs back through the hallway toward the kitchen while the zombie’s groan echoes behind her.
Amy slips under a loose floorboard in the pantry, pulls out a pistol tucked behind canned beans, and slides a gleaming katana from its sheath on the counter, readying both weapons.
Facing the first lunge of a zombie, she fires a single shot that sends it sprawling into the kitchen tiles.

A second creature surges forward; Amy swings the katana in a swift arc severing its neck cleanly, then spins to fire another round at a third zombie that stumbles from the hallway and crashes against the fridge.

The last zombie thuds dead on the floor; breathing hard, Amy grabs Will and Amber’s hands once more, hurried back through the closet door into the kitchen, and pushes them out of the house—safe at last.

phases.required_end_state: End at the expanded story's stated conclusion.
